note: Intent tasks for the agent test (DS-14). Each comes from one of the owner's real asks and never names a part; tasks.test.ts holds both rules. A task is never edited once frozen: a new one is added beside it with a new id.

tasks.prompt: On a sources page, removing a source also deletes its saved stories. Ask the person to confirm before that happens, and let them back out.
When the device goes offline, tell the person above the story list that new stories will not load until it reconnects. Keep the list usable while it shows.
Make a settings screen with two preferences: how long a briefing is (short, medium or long), and whether new episodes download on their own.
Let the person add a podcast feed by pasting its address. The form opens over the library from an add action, and the library stays behind it.
Let the person sort the library by newest, oldest or title.
After the person deletes a story from the library, give them a short moment to undo it.
Show something useful when the library has no saved stories yet, with a way to go and find stories to save.
Show one episode in a list: its title, the show's name, its length, and a way to start playing it right there.
